brand_identity.name: AVERO
brand_identity.logo_description: Black rounded-square symbol with a lime-green abstract 'A' mark. DO NOT redesign logo.
brand_identity.tagline: The All-in-One Hospitality Operating System for Cafes & Restaurants

usage_rules.primary_lime: Use for Primary CTA buttons, active sidebar item indicator, key metric highlight cards, table selection active state, primary status badge highlights. NEVER overuse as large flat backgrounds or full page gradients.
usage_rules.black: Header backgrounds (dark accents), dark buttons, primary typography in light mode, high contrast borders, structural framing.
usage_rules.light_bg: Default background for main workspace, dashboard cards backdrop, panel divider neutral tone.
usage_rules.dark_gray: Secondary headers, dark mode card surfaces, code/receipt view blocks, mobile bottom bar.

cafe.signature_style: Express counter-friendly quick billing view, barista queue timer metrics, warmth-infused warm stone accents over clean lime-black chassis.

restaurant.signature_style: Structured high-density grid, KOT kitchen board column headers, floor plan occupancy map, fine-dining table turnover meters.

font_families.heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif

rules.anti_default: DO NOT default to raw Inter or Roboto for headers or key metrics. Use Plus Jakarta Sans or Cabinet Grotesk for crisp hospitality authority.
rules.tight_headers: Always add tracking-tight to headlines larger than 24px.
rules.monospaced_numbers: Use font-mono for all order IDs, prices (₹), receipt totals, kitchen KOT timestamps, table numbers, and stock counts.

testing_attributes.mandatory_data_testid_rule: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, selects, tabs, workspace switcher) and key data cells must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Default theme is LIGHT mode with an explicit theme toggle switch in header or sidebar.
Cafe and Restaurant workspaces must display clearly distinguishable layout features and subtle accent badges while sharing the same Avero primary lime #B8FF00 / dark chassis.
Implement the landing page live countdown timer bar in IST format.
Use Lucide icons for clean SaaS iconography.
Do NOT create generic stock layouts — ensure realistic hospitality data (order numbers, dish names, tax GST/FSSAI, table occupancy) is rendered in clean tables and cards.
